title: Clinking Curio-Cuttlefish
statement: Nestled in a sun-dappled grotto of sunken sea glass and swaying kelp, this inquisitive cephalopod spends its days arranging tumbled pebbles into intricate, ever-changing mosaics that softly chime in the current. Whenever a visitor leans close, its skin ripples with warm, luminous constellations as it pauses its tinkering to trade a curious glance.
